raw_block.rationale: Creates a three-skill Illinois package that separates exemption reasoning from the two native OpenExempt renderings. It preserves exact asset names, combines the two debtors' $4,000 interests, and applies the uncapped health-aid exemption only to the prescribed prosthesis.
